eps.ov: Toya's need to be special borders on obsession. How far would he go to gain a talent, and what would he do once he finally has what he wants?
Toya may be part of The Forest of Greats now, but that won't stop people from having opinions about his talent.
Neumann mobilizes The Forest of Greats for an all-out offensive when the Tyrant King reveals himself.
The battle takes a turn for the worse. The Forest of the Greats may have formidable members, but so does the Army of the Sinners.
Power has a price. Returners have great talents, but what do they lose as a result?
Toya faces off against the leader of the Sinners. But when Xiang Yu only wishes to talk, the line between heroes and villains begins to blur.
Old enemies become new allies as old allies become new enemies.
With peace an impossibility, Toya and the others must decide what to do with the three months humanity has left. Fortunately, help arrives from an unexpected source.

eps.t: All Begins and Ends at the Seed
eps.ov: They must all decide what happens next.
Who is Alan Smithee and, more importantly, what does he have to do with the Branch of Reincarnation?
While Jubei and Toya try to save Haito, coordinated attacks on Rouge Returners begin.
Albert considers herself the real Einstein, not Ein.
Toya and Haito come to a mutual understanding.
